title: Solomon's Request to Hiram for Help with the Temple
description: Solomon musters workers and sends a message to King Hiram of Tyre, asking for a skilled craftsman and timber from Lebanon to build the house of the Lord. He promises payment in wheat, barley, wine, and oil. Hiram replies with a letter, praising the God of Israel, and sends the expert craftsman Huram-Abi. He pledges to cut down trees in Lebanon and float them by sea to Joppa.
